headline: D Developments Launches in Egypt with EGP 15 Billion Portfolio
summary: D Developments launched operations in Egypt through an Egyptian-Saudi partnership, targeting an initial investment portfolio of EGP 15 billion across four projects in Obour City.
why: Cross-border real estate partnerships bring foreign capital into local property markets, supporting regional construction activity.

impacts.name: D Developments
impacts.why: The newly launched firm is entering the market with a large EGP 15 billion target portfolio.
